title: Chapter 104 — Inventory: What Is Really in the Building
intro: Statuses, counts, shrink, and selling with inventory truth.

sections.title: Know What You Have
sections.content:
Inventory status is not just 'in stock' or 'out of stock.' It includes on-order, in-transit, on-display, reserved, damaged, and returned. Knowing the real status prevents promises you cannot keep.

Check inventory before quoting delivery dates. Verify availability before closing. Selling something you do not have creates a problem that is much harder to fix than checking a screen.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating inventory awareness, ask:

Does the salesperson check inventory status before making commitments?
Do they understand the difference between available, reserved, and on-order?
Are they setting accurate expectations — or promising and hoping?
